name_reason: Conforms to global naming convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: prefix data_fd2_, domain chapter, ch26 is a valid chapter ID (chapters 01-30, must be preserved -- not a Ghidra address residue), descriptor end_scene_char_facing_table accurately reflects both purpose (per-char end-scene facing direction) and data type (table). No address residue. Consistent with sibling tables (pos_x @ 0x522D6, pos_y @ 0x522E6) and the same naming used by chapters 21/22/23/30.
purpose: Chapter 26 end-scene per-slot facing-direction table: one byte per character slot (0..15) giving the direction each placed character faces during the chapter-26 post-battle scene.
logic_summary: byte[16] const table. The only reader, fd2_chapter_26_end (0x24E80), copies it (and its sibling pos_x @ 0x522D6 / pos_y @ 0x522E6 tables) onto stack scratch via MOVSD.REP (ECX=4 -> 4 dwords = 16 bytes each), then passes the facing pointer as arg3 to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which indexes it by char slot to set each character's facing direction. Bytes are uniform 0x02 (south) except slots 0 and 2 which are 0x00 (north).
element_semantics: One byte per character slot index (0..15) = facing-direction code in FD2's facing convention (0x00 = north/up, 0x02 = south/down). Actual content: {0x00,0x02,0x00,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02} -- slots 0 and 2 face north, all others face south.
notes: src comment block (chend2.c lines 572-578) is already accurate and concise (16-byte tables copied as four dwords, private read-only, only reader fd2_chapter_26_end, facing uniform 0x02 except slots 0 and 2 which face 0x00) -- matches the actual bytes, so src kept unchanged. Ghidra had no PLATE_COMMENT and an annotation misplaced in PRE_COMMENT (deprecated data-plate convention); created proper PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) and cleared the misplaced PRE_COMMENT, per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism. is_const=true: zero write-xrefs from game code (only two READ/DATA xrefs, both from fd2_chapter_26_end). Verdict-confirming xrefs: 0x24EB7 (DATA, MOV ESI,0x522f6) and 0x24EBC (READ, MOVSD.REP).
